title: Liz Heimerl-Rolland
body:
# Liz Heimerl-Rolland

# Board Vice President

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/heimerl-rolland-profile.png)

- Serves on the **[finance committee](https://www.wauwatosaschools.org/page/committees)** of the board. In 2024, **[poor budgeting](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sZ-q1_tIIi5bInyuEBhpVAGzXIDOAoKv/view)** created an $8.2 million budget overrun for the district. She **[admitted](https://www.fox6now.com/news/wauwatosa-school-district-budget-issues-4-million-mistake)**, “This wasn’t nefarious spending, the budget was put together poorly and nobody knew that,” Heimerl-Rolland said. (It’s the job of the school board to understand and approve the budget.)
- Leftist “No Kings” [](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/647ff9d5-e6da-4674-8fab-9d1b79ca9ed7/WI-Wauwatosa-Rolland-No-Kings.png)
- LGBT/BLM activist.
